items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: Well I played with Roy on a few jobs around Chicago.

ctx.x: Any other favorite musicians you've had on different instruments? Trombone, did you hear Roy Palmer much?
Well I played with Roy on a few jobs around Chicago. He had a nice round tone.
Jelly said he was his favorite trombonist.
